headline: US futures trade mixed ahead of heavy earnings slate and housing data as Europe weakens on ABB miss
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) are at -0.02%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) +0.20%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) -0.39%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) +0.01% indicating a mixed US open
- General Electric (GE), RTX (RTX), 3M (MMM), General Motors (GM), Northrop Grumman (NOC), Halliburton (HAL), and Synchrony Financial (SYF) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell
- Netflix (NFLX), Intuitive Surgical (ISRG), and Chubb (CB) are due to report earnings after the close
- US housing starts and building permits data are scheduled for 8:30 AM ET, with pending home sales due at 10 AM ET
- European bourses are indicated weaker, with ABB down nearly 4% after missing Q3 estimates while guiding FY26 revenue growth in the low teens
